label: Closed-collection rootedness: positive arguments, rivals and provisional judgment
summary: Analyst warrant assessment; no source was read, and every literature name below is an unread lead from memory, not an attribution. Meaning (DEF closed-collection rootedness): collect actual concreta together with every actual concrete ground of any of them; the collection contains something to which no actual concretum gives being. It forbids only rootless closed collections: a pure endless descent and a pure cycle. It allows endless descent and cycles above a root, and imposes no asymmetry, transitivity or finite-path condition. Positive arguments. (A) Dependence transmission ('borrowed reality'): wholly supplied being needs a supplier that is not itself supplied. Its collection form quantifies over all suppliers (NoWhollyBorrowedCollection, over every modelled actual supplier of the selected direct relation). It yields CCR only under the open bridge that actual concreta are supplied only by concreta (ActualSuppliersOfConcretaConcrete; closedRootedOfBorrowed, verified, zero axioms); without the bridge it does not (Control.abstractSupplier: an abstract item grounds every member of a concrete regress, the principle holds and CCR fails), because CCR closes only over actual concrete grounds and an actual root may have abstract or unmodelled grounds. (A) is offered as a necessary conceptual principle. Under direct grounding it supports CCR but not AGWF's surplus: one root that directly grounds every member of a descending chain (Control.limitGrounder, a direct root grounder despite the name) satisfies both. A foundation reached only through intermediaries, with no direct edge from the root to the chain (an omega+1 order under direct grounding, Control.mediateFoundation), violates CCR; Cameron-style foundations through infinitely many intermediaries (unread lead from #310) would be this case if they deny direct root edges, and treating them as rooted needs a mediate or transitive reading of grounds with its own bridge. (B) Per se attenuation (closedRootedOfAttenuation): valid, and it can fail: its load-bearing clauses are uniform loss and a common bound, and the network analogues show the weighted-network theorem fails without each (binaryFixed, halfFixed; no Profile-level control). The per se clause, own esse only at roots (intermediates contribute nothing of their own), is the traditional one; for the uniform-loss clause no independent justification is on file (the recollection that traditional instrument examples are not described as lossy is unread and carries no evidential weight). So 'intermediates have no power of their own' alone does not yield CCR: lossless per se reception is satisfied by the pure regress, which violates CCR. (C) Graded argument: the limit grounder satisfies ascent along a grade with a maximum while the grade has infinite ascent; with #1515's equivalence this shows grades supply no independent warrant for no infinite ascent, and none for CCR was found. Rivals (objection standard). R1 grounding infinitism (leads: Bohn, Morganti, Bliss, Schaffer 2003, Tahko; unread). Target: CCR (formal shape Control.pureRegress). Mechanism: an actual rootless closed collection, each member grounded by another, the totality accounted for memberwise or holistically. Independent justification offered: the conceivability or physical possibility of no fundamental level, mostly compositional (gunk). Relevance: CCR as used here is an actual-world premise, so a merely possible rootless collection does not falsify it directly; but (A) is offered as a necessary conceptual principle, so a genuinely possible wholly borrowed collection of sustained concreta would defeat (A) as a necessary truth and with it the warrant (A) gives CCR. The rival bears on the selected relation (present esse support) if that relation is compositional dependence of wholes on parts or if a positive account of source-free real sustaining is given (#310: a coinductive or global fixed-point reading). Price: an actual collection whose being is supplied by nothing outside it, with no member having being otherwise. Status: the strongest standing rival; not refuted; no established counterexample. R2 coherentism or symmetric dependence (leads: Thompson 2016, Barnes 2018, Swanson; unread). Against CCR only for pure cycles; rooted cycles satisfy CCR (Control.rootedCycle), so against the join the rival must claim a pure cycle of sustaining with nothing outside it. (A recollection that its examples concern identity or nature dependence rather than sustaining of concrete existence is unread and carries no evidential weight.) It remains a substantive objection to asymmetry and to J2 (both still needed off the join's coverage routes). R3 infinite descending chains with a root that directly grounds every member: not a rival to CCR, a model of it; a rival only to AGWF and to no infinite ascent, and the coverage routes now accommodate it. A foundation reached only through intermediaries is, under direct grounding, a counterexample to CCR (Control.mediateFoundation) and stands with R1 unless a mediate-grounding bridge is supplied. R4 unbounded ascent: as recorded for the graded batch, it targets only the global no-infinite-ascent premise. Overall provisional judgment (revisable; not establishment): on the coverage routes of the join (underivedOfCoverageClosed and the two from-necessity routes), the regress commitment is strictly lowered from AGWF to CCR; the checks route still takes J2. Support for the join's regress step on those routes is modestly higher than under AGWF, for direct-foundation views: a root that directly grounds a descending chain, or a cycle, is compatible with it. Pure infinitism, pure coherentism and foundation only through intermediaries (under direct grounding) remain rivals, each with an actual closed collection of sustained concreta that no actual concretum outside it supplies. Positive warrant for CCR rests mainly on (A) together with the concrete-supplier bridge; (B) adds little until uniform loss is independently motivated. Neither rival is refuted.
blocker: Revision conditions: a defended mediate (transitive) reading of the selected relation under which foundations through intermediaries count as roots; a defended view on which abstract items sustain concreta (denying the concrete-supplier bridge); an account on which the selected sustaining relation is compositional over actual gunky parts; a defended source-free global fixed-point account of real sustaining (#310 ACT-GROUND); an independent motivation for uniform attenuation of received being (would upgrade B); an established pure cycle of existential sustaining. Next tests: read one infinitist source (Morganti or Bohn) and Cameron 2008 sections 1 and 4-6 before citing them; test whether a weaker per se clause (things with partly own esse) still gives CCR; investigate a collection-level warrant for CCR that does not reduce to it (for example a PSR for closed collections, #312).
